channel.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
channel.description: National news and headlines from within or around India with live updates on major breaking events from The Hindu.

image.title: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu

item.title: Madras High Court upholds Tamil Nadu Assembly Speaker’s decision to accept resignations of six AIADMK MLAs
item.description: Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan, however, direct him to conclude the disqualification proceedings pending against four out of the six MLAs within two months

item.title: After The Hindu report, Collector orders GMR to repair roads damaged in Bhogapuram airport construction
item.description: Vizianagaram Collector S. Ramsundar Reddy also asks NHAI to connect the airport to the highway’s service roads; NHAI says the changes will be made in a couple of weeks

item.title: Karnataka Home Minister says police directed not to disrupt peaceful demonstration
item.description: This comes a day after Bengaluru police detained over a 100 persons for trying to march to the office of Chief Electoral Officer (CEO), Karnataka to protest against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls

item.title: Jantar Mantar: From astronomical observatory to landmark protest site
item.description: The Delhi Jantar Mantar, originally known as Yantra Mantra, was built by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II of Jaipur as an astronomical observatory at the behest of Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah

item.title: MDR on UPI: Keralam hotels association says will stop accepting UPI payments above ₹2,000 from October 15
item.description: Announcement following introduction of 0.4% UPI merchant discount rate, which the association says will impose additional financial burden on small establishments

item.title: Anti-CEC protests LIVE: CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka detained; Delhi High Court to hear pleas on protest SOPs
item.description: The Supreme Court will hear pleas challenging the closure of several Delhi Metro stations amid protests against the Chief Election Commissioner.

item.title: IAS officer booked for assault on police at bar and restaurant in Bengaluru
item.description: The IAS officer and three others have been booked for allegedly assaulting a police inspector and other police personnel, abusing them, and obstructing them from discharging their duty while inspecting a pub in Bengaluru

item.title: India grows ‘with the world, not at anyone's cost’, cites strong economic fundamentals, says PM Modi
item.description: The Prime Minister cited the country's 7.8% economic growth in the April-June quarter, foreign-exchange reserves exceeding $700 billion and reforms spanning taxation, insolvency and labour laws as evidence of its resilience

item.title: Tamil Nadu CM Vijay to meet Naidu today: Krishna water for Chennai on agenda
item.description: Under the 1983 Telugu Ganga agreement 15 TMC is to be delivered annually at the Tamil Nadu border; low storage in Srisailam, Somasila and Kandaleru makes a partial release the likely compromise, sources say

item.title: Interim zone of influence around Pallikaranai marshland can be restricted to 36 survey numbers, State Wetlands Authority tells Madras High Court
item.description: Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan decide to pass orders on October 14, 2026 regarding restriction of interim ZoI to 128.19 hectares

item.title: Supreme Court stays defamation case proceedings against Rahul Gandhi over 2019 remarks against PM
item.description: A Bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Kumar Singh issued notices to the Maharashtra government and the complainant, M H. Shrishrimal, seeking their responses in four weeks

item.title: Kochi Corporation to survey public taps to curb water bills
item.description: Survey to identify unused and illegally installed public taps. Corporation to take steps to geo-tag and meter those currently in use

item.title: 60% notice cases verified in Delhi; disposal gains pace amid reduced scrutiny, norms
item.description: The sudden spike in the rate of notice disposal follows the introduction of new options on the ECINET portal and fresh oral directions from Gyanesh Kumar’s office to expedite the process and prevent wrongful deletions

item.title: Hanging by a thread, pigeon gets a lifeline from Fire and Rescue Services
item.description: The pigeon’s leg had become entangled in a thread beneath the parapet of a bakery building, leaving it suspended in the air with no way to free itself. Fire and rescue officer Mohammad Shafeeq used a harness and rope to descend towards the trapped bird and bring it to safety.

item.title: 2,200 personnel to secure India-West Indies T20 match at Hyderabad’s Uppal stadium on October 14
item.description: Around 40,000 spectators expected for the match scheduled to begin at 7 p.m; police identified parking space for 8,000 vehicles and announce heavy-vehicle diversions around stadium

item.title: Investigation reveals collection of ‘party fund’ during Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi’s tenure as School Education Minister, CCB tells Madras High Court
item.description: It makes the submission in a counter affidavit filed before Justice V. Lakshminarayanan in response to the former Minister’s plea to quash the FIR against him

item.title: Congress Seva Dal seeks case against Bhaskar Rao over ‘fake news’ on Dhruv Rathee
item.description: In a representation dated October 10, Junaid P.K., president of the Brigade, alleged that Mr. Rao had created doubts about Mr. Rathee’s nationality by suggesting that he could be a foreign national.

item.title: The baby who became the face of KSRTC’s Airavat Club Class buses
item.description: Nearly two decades after a simple advertising photograph was taken, a sleeping baby in a stroller continues to travel across Karnataka and other neighboring States on KSRTC’s luxury buses. Bengaluru-based commercial photographer Senthil Kumar Muruganandhan recalls how the memorable image came to life

item.title: What is the electoral roll cyber scam in which a 79-year-old Pune man lost ₹11.92 lakh?
item.description: The case raises questions about how banking credentials were compromised and whether personal information associated with electoral applications was obtained through phishing or other means

item.title: 13 held in Manipur for circulating explicit content on social media
item.description: Police said they launched an investigation, codenamed 'Operation Dignity ', and arrested 12 people and detained a juvenile

item.title: CJP’s Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka, Ajinkya Shinde detained near Jantar Mantar; Dipke says ‘cannot de-notify resistance’
item.description: On October 12, 2026, the Delhi police de-notified Jantar Mantar as a designated venue for protests and demonstrations

item.title: Comparing SIR 2002-04 and 2025-26
item.description: Unlike previous SIRs, which had elaborate processes for preparing fresh rolls to ensure that no eligible elector would be taken off the rolls, the current SIR exercise adopts a flawed process that has led to the exclusion of lakhs of eligible voters; a point-by-point comparison is provided

item.title: ADNOC open to further long-term LPG deals with India, sees India among most important energy markets: Acting CEO, Downstream
item.description: ADNOC supplied more than 500,000 barrels of crude a day to India in 2025, “almost one in ten barrels of [India’s] crude imports”. The company is exploring opportunities with ISPRL to expand storage of crude oil, LNG and LPG, including strategic reserves

item.title: Government not only ‘stealing’ votes but also savings: Congress on rise in inflation
item.description: Jairam Ramesh said retail inflation hit its highest level in 23 months in September, with food inflation at 7.74% and onion prices up 108%

item.title: Elon Musk and Mukesh Ambani’s feud over Starlink | Explained
item.description: Elon Musk believes that India’s mobile internet market is skewed to favour the Ambani family and that his Starlink service deserves a fair chance in the country. However, critics have pointed to sovereignty and security concerns

item.title: MDMA seized from inmates at Kannur women’s prison; case registered
item.description: According to police, the banned substance was allegedly brought into the prison illegally and kept for consumption by inmates

item.title: Gujarat civic polls: Counting underway in Gandhinagar, other local bodies
item.description: BJP has governed the GMC for the last five years. This time, the BJP, Congress and Aam Aadmi Party are the main contenders in Gandhinagar

item.title: Vijayendra claims 25 Congress MLAs, including Ministers, will jump ship ahead of Assembly polls
item.description: B. Y. Vijayendra, the Karnataka BJP state president, claimed on Monday that more than 25 Congress MLAs, including ministers, are poised to defect to the BJP ahead of the state Assembly elections in Bengaluru, accusing the Congress government of political “debauchery” and mismanaging drought relief.

item.title: Madrasa teacher from Lakshadweep arrested for sexually assaulting 9-year-old girl on ship to Kochi
item.description: After the girl informed her mother about the incident, they alerted the ship’s security personnel, who detained the accused

item.title: Forest ‘violations’ in Keralam’s Chalakudy division come under scrutiny
item.description: Greens claim up to 20,000 trees may be cut for installing solar fence in the area. Supreme Court-constituted Central Empowered Committee earlier directed Keralam Forest department and VACB to jointly submit their response

item.title: Rare Gajalakshmi sculpture from Rashtrakuta period found in neglect in Telangana’s Medak
item.description: A team of heritage activists and historians, in association with members of Kotha Telangana Charitra Brundam (KTCB), visited the site to examine the sculpture.

item.title: Delhi Police registers two FIRs over Opposition protest
item.description: According to police, no permission had been granted for the march to the Supreme Court and several opposition leaders were allegedly seen breaking police barricades with the help of a mini-truck during the protest on Monday.

item.title: Despite Transport Minister’s surprise checks, commuters say BMTC bus service issues persist
item.description: Passengers flag buses skipping designated stops, rude behaviour by crew; however digital payments have eased change-related problems

item.title: Post against CJI: KPCC president says person responsible for X post removed from party position
item.description: The Congress party had no differences of opinion regarding the impartiality of the courts, Mr. Joseph said

item.title: Reservation cannot be proportionate to population of castes, says Karnataka High Court
item.description: Accepting population as the basis for reservation would be ‘destructive of the principle of equality’, the court says

item.title: Karnataka High Court strikes down law to increase reservation for SCs/STs, declares it unconstitutional
item.description: Court says 50% ceiling on total reservation is binding constitutional principle

item.title: Rahul Gandhi’s plea not listed for hearing on October 13, faces routine clerical hurdles
item.description: Under the Supreme Court Rules, when a petition has defects, the petitioner is typically given a time window, such as 28 days or standard registry timelines, depending on the specific filing chapter to cure the defects

item.title: J&K Waqf Board pushes for uniform Friday sermons, ‘preachers’ committee to decide topics in advance’
Why does India need a trained workforce for elderly care?
item.description: India’s 60-plus population is projected to touch 347 million by 2050, underscoring the need for a robust caregiving ecosystem; a formal training programme, building on existing small-scale initiatives, could promote gender parity in caregiving and recognise informal, unpaid family caregivers

item.title: The gaps in the implementation of the RTI Act
item.description: Section 4 of the RTI Act lists 16 types of information which are to be disclosed by public authorities; such voluntary disclosure has not been followed

item.title: IISc study says strong magnetic fields could allow white dwarfs to grow beyond the Chandrasekhar limit
Drought report: On southwest monsoon, drought in Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh
item.description: The Centre must help States once inter-ministerial team gives finding

item.title: Deep conspiracy to bring in ultra-leftist mindset: Fadnavis slams Congress as ‘anti-constitutional’
item.description: Congress wants to create anarchy in the country. It is a conspiracy to undermine the Constitution written by Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar and the institutions created by him, says Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis

item.title: Keralam Senior Citizens (Care and Protection) Bill to focus on protection of rights, dignity of elderly
item.description: The Bill that will be tabled in the Assembly on October 13 also aims at promoting active ageing, regulation of senior citizen care centres, and capacity-building for family and caregivers

item.title: Display rates of healthcare services prominently, Centre tells States
item.description: Clearly visible display will enable patients to take informed decisions, build trust, prevent billing-related disputes; Health Ministry also urges clinical establishments to display package rates for international patients visiting India on medical and Ayush visas

item.title: RLM suspends Ram Pukar Sinha, MLC candidate backed by three rebel party MLAs
item.description: On October 5, Ram Pukar Sinha filed the nomination as an independent candidate for the upcoming Legislative Council election in Saran Teachers Constituency

item.title: Arlekar new full-time Governor of T.N., Sudha Yadav to take charge in Karnataka in new gubernatorial appointments
item.description: O.P. Mathur to now serve as Governor of Keralam; Braj Mohan Ram to be Governor of Odisha, Dhal Singh Bisen Governor of Uttarakhand and former BJP general secretary Dushyant Gautam Governor of Sikkim

item.title: Winning, differently: On the by-election results in West Bengal, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry
item.description: Ruling parties sweep by-elections, but defections mar Tamil Nadu results

item.title: Berlin to BITS Pilani: How Nobel-winning optogenetics connects to parasite research in Hyderabad
item.description: Light has become more than a means of observation; it is a way to intervene, test, and uncover cause-and-effect relationships, said Nishith Gupta, professor of Biological Sciences at BITS Pilan

item.title: Mehbooba Mufti opposes motorable boulevard on western side of famous Dal Lake
item.description: Why destroy Nigeen Lake’s tranquillity? Kashmir needs ecological protection, not divisive politics, says PDP chief Mehbooba Mufti

item.title: Restrictions on firecrackers: Supreme Court urges balance between religious sentiments and public health
item.description: Justice Joymalya Bagchi questions religious basis for bursting firecrackers; CJI cautions against restrictions which cannot be enforced on the ground, says people should be educated to reject harmful cracker varieties

item.title: Delhi police accused of beating, assaulting detainees, denying them basic rights
item.description: Detainees report being transported in ‘prison vans’, verbally and physically abused, denied water; one group taken to isolated police camp, seated in rows, and systematically beaten by police after their phones were confiscated

item.title: Demolition of tribals’ houses in M.P. draws Shivraj’s anger; says ‘Mohan ji became CM with their votes’
item.description: On October 11, houses of about 12 tribal families in Kosmi village were demolished by the Forest Department over alleged encroachment

item.title: Delhi protests against CEC: What the law says about preventive detention | Explained
item.description: The Supreme Court directed the Union government and the Delhi Police to stop illegal detentions and allow free and smooth movement of people and traffic, as well as the operations of Metro and rail services, but “subject to law and public order”

item.title: Police crack down on anti-SIR protesters in Bengaluru, detain 100
item.description: The police threatened journalists covering the protest and ordered them to leave the spot, while three photographers were manhandled, despite repeatedly identifying themselves as members of the Press.

item.title: West Bengal bypolls proved that BJP does not draw support from just one community: CM Suvendu
item.description: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari had earlier said that 80% of the Muslims in Nandigram and 60% of the minority population in Rejinagar had voted for the BJP in the bypolls held on October 6

item.title: SIR needed every five years to check influx: Assam CM
item.description: Himanta Biswa Sarma cites the demographic shift in four eastern States to drive home his point

item.title: Bombay HC orders accused in Goa fire case to deposit interim compensation of ₹20 lakh each
item.description: The Court directed that the “deposit would be subject to final contentions in the main matter”

item.title: Speaker rejects objection over the use of ‘Kerala Niyamasabha’ for official purposes
Govt. move to de-notify Jantar Mantar follows SC suggestion that protest sites need more space, open air
item.description: A four-page court order passed on October 9 records the Supreme Court Bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant urging the government to look for a ‘spacious, open’ alternative site in Delhi
